story: Sleeping Giant State Park is a forest located in Connecticut, USA. It is named for its resemblance to a slumbering human figure and features a rugged traprock mountain. The park spans 1,500 acres and offers expansive clifftop vistas.
matters: The park is part of the narrow, linear Metacomet Ridge. It hosts unusual microclimates that support several plant and animal species that are state-listed or globally rare.
name: Sleeping Giant State Park
